note: gameTasks@2 · ch01. PK-R3b (doc 41 §1/§2): the FIELD palette is choice · wheel · restore · oddone; the boss ritual and the finale keep their scripted kinds. `restore` is the chapter's core mechanic — name the greyed being, then give its colour back. PK-R6 · D (doc 44 §3.3): the `rescue` pool is Merle's REAWAKENING — six rounds in file order, one per painted wrong-action pose, all bound to skin `merle`. PK-R6 · F: the set now belongs to the restaged world — the contraction class (doc 44 B20) is asked by a being that POINTS at a staged object, the number quickfires run on a moth swarm in every phase, the door series carries the unit's negations and its question, and the guardian's cards wear the cell she is actually in when they open (`tafel_land1` in the counter-window, `tafel_rest` when she is beaten).
